name: CSS Minifier
summary: Minify CSS by stripping comments and whitespace — instantly in your browser.
description: Shrink stylesheets for production by removing comments and unnecessary whitespace while preserving string contents. See a live size-savings percentage.

faqs.question: Will minification break my CSS?
faqs.answer: It is safe for typical stylesheets. Quoted strings are preserved. Extremely unusual hacks may need a full CSS toolchain.

faqs.question: Are comments removed?
faqs.answer: Yes. Comments are stripped as part of minification.

faqs.question: Is my CSS uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Minification runs entirely in your browser.
